inputs.model.prompt:
Take the attached motorcycle as the design reference and rebuild it as a dynamic hero shot for a motorcycle-magazine cover poster: vertical frame, flat deep crimson red field, white type and one orange accent. The bike is redrawn from a low front-left three-quarter angle, leaning into the frame, its bodywork sharpened into a cleaner graphic look with strong specular highlights, front wheel turned, motion blur on both rims and bright horizontal speed streaks across the background, a thin haze of tyre smoke drifting off the rear wheel. Remove the rear paddock stand completely: the rear wheel rests on the ground with clean tyre contact and a soft shadow, nothing supporting the bike.

A huge white condensed headline "HY IMAGE 3.5" runs across the top with "PREVIEW" directly beneath it, both lines edge to edge and tilted with the bike. An oversized translucent pale-red "PREVIEW" runs diagonally behind the machine. Along the left edge, three thin-bordered cards are headed "TEXT RENDERING", "PHOTOREALISM" and "EDIT CONSISTENCY". Small edge labels: "PREVIEW BUILD" top-left, "TENCENT HUNYUAN" rotated on the right edge, "2026.09" bottom-right.

Low-angle camera, hard key light from the upper left, strict grid, generous negative space, nothing overlapping the bike. Ultra-high resolution, crisp edges, print-ready.
